title: [main] Bug 652332 Issuing multiple Reminders or Finance Charge Memos with Print, produces a PDF only for the last one
summary: Fixed an issue where issuing multiple reminders or finance charge memos with the print option would only generate a PDF for the last document. The fix batches all issued documents into a single print invocation so the PDF includes all selected documents.
key_points: Printing multiple reminders or finance charge memos now produces a single PDF containing all documents instead of only the last one
Documents are batched into one print call rather than printed individually
Email processing for these documents remains unchanged
Changes applied to both base application and localization layers
Test coverage added for the fix
quote: Batch all issued documents into a single print invocation so the generated PDF includes every selected Reminder or Finance Charge Memo.
